title: The Compass That Learned Surrender

features.name: the spiralled needle
features.desc-on-touch: The compass needle has learned to point inward and downward, spiralling into itself. It hums a frequency that your chest recognizes.

features.name: scattered charts
features.desc-on-touch: Maps and navigation documents lie open, their grid lines fading. Some point to places that exist; others to places that have learned to disappear.

features.name: the cairn without direction
features.desc-on-touch: Stones balanced without intention, pointing nowhere. You place your hand on it and feel the weight of having nowhere left to go.

features.name: the pool that forgets reflection
features.desc-on-touch: Still water that shows only grey. You've learned not to ask it where you are, only where you have stopped wanting to go.

features.name: the four grasses
features.desc-on-touch: Four tall reeds grow at the four cardinal points, but they're identical. They sway together, teaching each other that north and south were only words.

features.name: the resting bench
features.desc-on-touch: A weathered seat facing no particular way. People sit here not to recover direction, but to accept its absence.

inscription: where wanting to know where you are is the last thing to go
